hooks.text: 攻击会自动跟随音乐节奏，玩家精准踩拍还能进一步强化攻击。
hooks.excerpt: RHYTHM: Auto-Attack to the Rhythm of the Music! Press to the Rhythm to power up your Attacks!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 连击计数可被长按攻击消耗，而长按攻击会自动命中节拍，让注意力转向战斗。
hooks.excerpt: HOLD COMBO: Build up your Combo Counter and consume it with Hold Attacks! Hold Attacks auto-hit the Rhythm, letting you focus on Combat!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次击败局末首领后重温 Roxie 的记忆，逐步拼出音乐场馆毁灭后的悲剧。
hooks.excerpt: After defeating Boss Fights at the end of your run, re-live Roxie’s memories and piece together her tragic story.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 视觉过度拥挤导致难以看清受击来源

excerpts.excerpt: Everything is visually cluttered and, from time to time, you can only wonder what hit you
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 独特美术风格非常讨喜

excerpts.excerpt: artstyle is very unique and nice looking. I like it very much.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the overall gameplay is repetitive and boring
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期几乎不需闪避即可秒杀敌人

excerpts.excerpt: I don't have to dodge because i kill every enemy instantly
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

关卡越来越长且乐趣下降

excerpts.excerpt: the more i play the game I less enjoy it. Levels keeps getting longer

opinions.text: 节拍系统对初学者友好
